appraisal_events.evidence: « Oh ! je le connais depuis si longtemps, répondit Cottard. »
appraisal_events.explanation: After blushing when Forcheville had to explain the pun to him, Cottard deflects with a claim of long familiarity, a transparent face-saving move the narration quietly undercuts.

status_effects.explanation: His evasive claim to have long known the joke, coming right after his embarrassed blush, is a mild, ironized dent to his self-presentation.

ambiguities: Forcheville and Odette appear only inside the interaction already captured by the accepted annotation (Swann's jealous appeal to the little phrase regarding Odette and Forcheville); the passage gives them no distinct local outcome of their own, so both are omitted per supplement scope rules.
